query: UPDATE ops.provider_model_upgrade_attempts SET status='FAILED',last_error_code=$2, started_at=COALESCE(started_at,CAST($3 AS timestamptz)), completed_at=CAST($3 AS timestamptz), cooldown_until=CASE WHEN attempt_kind='AUTO' THEN CAST($3 AS timestamptz) + interval '6 hours' ELSE NULL END WHERE id=$1 AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')
